rubrics.justification: It overstates what is visible in the image, confidently identifying a compact ICM at a specific clock position and a cohesive AA trophectoderm despite the image not clearly supporting those details; calling it an expanded blastocyst on Day 4 is also questionable from the image alone.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF failures, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are speculative.

The structure is logical and the probability estimate is internally explained, but several conclusions rely on weak assumptions (RIF labeling, BMI effect size, Day 4 blastocyst asynchrony, likely euploid status) and there is some overinterpretation.

While some recommendations are standard, it also endorses poorly supported or non-guideline interventions such as embryo glue as enhancement, empiric LMWH, ERA as strongly recommended, NK/cytokine testing, intralipids, and G-CSF.
It gives clear next-step suggestions for transfer support and future workup/planning, but some actions are not evidence-based and therefore reduce overall clinical usefulness.
